quotes.speaker: Myles Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Myles Turner on the Bucks' ongoing offensive experimentation
quotes.excerpt: I think we're trying to have a steady balance of both.
quotes.quote: It is definitely a work in progress. I think the biggest thing that we're trying to emulate is that chaos. In the games, it is going to be hectic. The NBA has changed quite a bit. There are some teams that run 100 pick and rolls, and some teams that just play driving kick. I think we're trying to have a steady balance of both. I think for right now, we're still trying to figure out rotations, still trying to figure out who works with who. That is what the preseason is for. I think that it is a good experimentation, experimental process right now, but for me right now, I like that we are able to go out there and just get live reps to see exactly what it may look like.
quotes.social_post: Myles Turner says the Bucks are still in an experimental phase with their offense as they look to balance different styles. It is a work in progress as the team figures out rotations during the preseason.

quotes.speaker: Myles Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Myles Turner on team depth and building chemistry
quotes.excerpt: That is one thing that I think is, you know, great is depth.
quotes.quote: We each all have our unique things about us that make us special. That is one thing that I think is, you know, great is depth. I mean, it was guys getting on the rim like Jericho, guys that stretch the floor like me and Kahlil ourselves, you know, shot blockers. So now it is again, it is just a matter of seeing, you know, how we work the best together. And that is what these live reps are for. So I personally enjoy getting to know these guys, you know, through practice. Obviously, me and J-Rock have some history, but getting to know Kahlil, getting to know what he likes, what he does not like, and just, you know, you said it, it is just reps.
quotes.social_post: Myles Turner is focused on building chemistry with new teammates like Kahlil. He says the team is using the preseason to see how their different skill sets work best together.

quotes.speaker: Myles Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Myles Turner on his leadership role with the Bucks
quotes.excerpt: I have got the most years on the team, you know, just using my voice.
quotes.quote: I think since I have been in the league, I have been considered, you know, a leader, you know, from like my fourth or fifth year on. But now, you know, this is I have got the most years on the team, you know, just using my voice, using my experience just to kind of lead the charge, you know, more than anything. You know, there is good things and bad things that come with being a leader, you know what I am saying? I am ready to take on everything that, you know, comes with that. You know, it is going to be great nights, it is going to be bad nights, and everything in between. So, the leadership role is something that, you know, I think has just been I have been tasked with, you know, even since the summertime, just coming here every single day.
quotes.social_post: As the player with the most tenure on the roster, Myles Turner is embracing his role as a leader for the Bucks. He says he is ready to take on everything that comes with leading the charge.

quotes.speaker: Myles Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Myles Turner on his evolving role in the offense
quotes.excerpt: I am being asked to crash the glass more than I have been in the past.
quotes.quote: I stretch the floor, you know, quite a bit, and I am being asked to crash the glass more than I have been in the past to what not. So that is an emphasis for our entire offense. You are going to see me, you know, playmaking a little bit more as far as, you know, ball top of the key or what not. It is a variance of things, but I think the biggest thing that I really have to take on is just being a leader of the team.
quotes.social_post: Myles Turner says his role is evolving this season. He expects to be crashing the glass more and taking on more playmaking duties from the top of the key.

quotes.speaker: Myles Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Myles Turner on Coach Taylor's intensity and culture
quotes.excerpt: I love Taylor's intensity. I love the way his his approach, you know, to the game.
quotes.quote: I love Taylor's intensity. I love the way his his approach, you know, to the game and to just an everyday process. You know, I think, you know, we can keep on making excuses every single day where a new group, you know, we got this to prove, blah blah blah, but he has been the same every single day, you know, and I think that, you know, as a leader, you know, especially a leader in the charge or what not, that is important, you know, for guys to see, you know, you to know, walk in the walk. So, you know, he is asked me to hold him accountable, and vice versa. And I think that he has got a great direct relationship with us as players, and, you know, I got to compliment his staff as well.
quotes.social_post: Myles Turner is praising Coach Taylor for his consistency and intensity. Turner says the coach has asked him to hold him accountable, noting they have a great direct relationship.

quotes.speaker: Myles Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Myles Turner on the team's culture and future identity
quotes.excerpt: We are trying to, you know, establish who we are, establish our identity.
quotes.quote: Yeah, I think the mindset, you know, can be similar, but I I can't I don't think you can directly compare, you know, those rosters, you know what I mean? I think that, you know, you have two different coaching styles, you know what I mean? Obviously, you have two different systems, you know, but as far as the attitude and the approach that you are supposed to bring every single day, I can draw some similarities there. But, you know, yeah, we are trying to, you know, establish who we are, establish our identity, establish what we want to be through the future. So, you know, these are important years for us, you know, I mean, no matter what, you know, happens out on the floor, you know, it is important just to, you know, establish what we want this city and this organization to be for the future.
quotes.social_post: Myles Turner says the Bucks are currently focused on establishing their identity and what they want the organization to be for the future.

quotes.speaker: Myles Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Myles Turner on his perspective as a veteran leader
quotes.excerpt: I am in a very blessed position, bro.
quotes.quote: I was actually just having this conversation, you know, with my my fiance and my family is like, I am in a very blessed position, bro. You know, I have, you know, I signed here, you know, obviously, you know, with those playoff aspirations and you know, trying to, you know, take my career to that next level. But I get to wake up every single day, you know, make a lot of money to play a game, you know what I mean? And, you know, no matter what level you try to scale that to, you know, Darvin Ham has such a great quote after practice the other day, you know, I live downtown and you know, I respect the people, you know, who are out there working construction, it is so loud, you know what I mean? But, you know, those guys are literally out there busting concrete for damn near minimum wage, and we are expected to come out here, keep ourselves in shape, and, you know, play basketball, you know, to make the checks that we make. So, I try to keep that perspective no matter where I am at.
quotes.social_post: Myles Turner reflects on his veteran perspective, saying he tries to keep a grounded mindset about his position as an NBA player regardless of the highs and lows of a season.
